CONSTANTS.V: Set of values that may be broadcast

SymbolOf.description: Canonical mapping assigning each node its unique share symbol
SymbolOf.instance: SymbolOf == CHOOSE f \in [P -> Symbols] : \A p, q \in P : (p # q) => (f[p] # f[q])

receivedS.description: Mapping from each process to the value it has received from the sender
receivedS.init: If sender ∈ Correct, receivedS maps all correct processes to a chosen value; otherwise unconstrained mapped to V ∪ {""}

delivered.description: Delivered value of each correct process, or empty string if undecided
delivered.init: All correct processes initially map to empty string

receivedRep.description: receivedRep[p][v] is the set of processes whose BCB-REP(v) signature share has been received by p
receivedRep.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct and v ∈ V

receivedFinal.description: receivedFinal[p][v] is TRUE if p has received a valid BCB-FINAL(v) with combined signature
receivedFinal.init: Initially FALSE for all p ∈ Correct and v ∈ V

receivedDis.description: For each node p and symbol sym, receivedDis[p][sym] is the set of senders who sent DISPERSE(sym) to p
receivedDis.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct and sym ∈ Symbols

mStar.description: Each node's fixed dispersal symbol ("" if not yet fixed)
mStar.init: All correct processes initially map to empty string

receivedRec.description: For each node p, set of received RECONSTRUCT pairs <<src,val>>
receivedRec.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct

receivedReady.description: receivedReady[p] is the set of processes whose READY has been received by p
receivedReady.init: Initially empty for all p ∈ Correct

decodeRound.description: Current online error-correction round r for each node
decodeRound.init: All correct processes initially map to 0

ACTIONS.name: SendFinal(self)
condition: ∃ v ∈ V : |receivedRep[self][v]| ≥ N - F ∧ receivedFinal[self][v] = FALSE

ACTIONS.name: TryDecodeAndReady(self)
effect: Let matching = { p ∈ P : <<p, SymbolOf[p]>> ∈ receivedRec[self] }
Else if r < F then decodeRound[self] := r + 1

ACTIONS.name: StepCommit(self)
condition: ∃ v ∈ V : (Let matching = { p ∈ P : <<p, SymbolOf[p]>> ∈ receivedRec[self] } in |matching| ≥ 2F + 1)

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineRep(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ v ∈ V : self ∉ receivedRep[d][v] ∧ receivedRep[d][v] := receivedRep[d][v] ∪ {self}

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineFinal(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ v ∈ V : receivedFinal[d][v] = FALSE ∧ receivedFinal[d][v] := TRUE

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineDisperse(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ sym ∈ Symbols : self ∉ receivedDis[d][sym] ∧ receivedDis[d][sym] := receivedDis[d][sym] ∪ {self}

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineReconstruct(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct, ∃ sym ∈ Symbols : <<self, sym>> ∉ receivedRec[d] ∧ receivedRec[d] := receivedRec[d] ∪ {<<self, sym>>}

ACTIONS.name: ByzantineReady(self)
effect: ∃ d ∈ Correct : self ∉ receivedReady[d] ∧ receivedReady[d] := receivedReady[d] ∪ {self}

ACTIONS.name: Next
effect: (∃ self ∈ Correct : SendRep(self) OR SendFinal(self) OR SendDisperse(self) OR ReceiveDisperse(self) OR SendReconstruct(self) OR TryDecodeAndReady(self) OR StepCommit(self))
(∃ self ∈ Faulty : ByzantineRep(self) OR ByzantineFinal(self) OR ByzantineDisperse(self) OR ByzantineReconstruct(self) OR ByzantineReady(self))
ACTIONS.description: Global step relation: some correct process executes one of its enabled actions, or some faulty process acts.

ACTIONS.name: Spec
effect: ∀ self ∈ Correct : WF_vars(SendRep(self) OR SendFinal(self) OR SendDisperse(self) OR ReceiveDisperse(self) OR SendReconstruct(self) OR TryDecodeAndReady(self) OR StepCommit(self))
ACTIONS.description: Full system spec: initial condition, step relation, and weak fairness for correct-process actions.

INVARIANTS.name: TypeInv
INVARIANTS.description: All variables remain within their declared types

INVARIANTS.name: Consistency
INVARIANTS.description: No two correct processes decide different values
INVARIANTS.spec_instance: ∀ p, q ∈ Correct : (delivered[p] ≠ "" ∧ delivered[q] ≠ "") ⇒ delivered[p] = delivered[q]

PROPERTIES.name: Validity
PROPERTIES.description: If the sender is correct, all correct processes eventually decide its value
PROPERTIES.spec_instance: (sender ∈ Correct) ⇒ LET Val == IF sender ∈ Correct THEN receivedS[sender] ELSE "" IN ◇(∀ p ∈ Correct : delivered[p] = Val)

PROPERTIES.name: Validity
PROPERTIES.description: If the broadcaster is correct, all correct processes eventually decide its value

llm_hint.receivedS: receivedS[p] models the value received from the sender in BCB-SEND round
llm_hint.receivedRep: receivedRep[p][v] abstracts the set of signature shares for value v received by p in BCB-REP round
llm_hint.receivedFinal: receivedFinal[p][v] models whether p has received a valid combined threshold signature for v in BCB-FINAL round
llm_hint.receivedDis: receivedDis[p][sym] abstracts the set of senders whose DISPERSE(sym) has been received by p
llm_hint.mStar: mStar[p] is the fixed dispersal symbol for process p after receiving t+1 matching DISPERSE messages
llm_hint.receivedRec: receivedRec[p] stores all <<src,val>> pairs received by p in RECONSTRUCT round
llm_hint.receivedReady: receivedReady[p] is the set of processes whose READY has been received by p
llm_hint.decodeRound: decodeRound[p] tracks the current online error-correction round (0 to t) for process p
llm_hint.Byzantine_model: Faulty processes may arbitrarily inject BCB-REP, BCB-FINAL, DISPERSE, RECONSTRUCT, or READY messages to any correct process
llm_hint.no_message_queue: Explicit message queues are abstracted away in favor of set-based reception state
llm_hint.threshold_signature_abstraction: Threshold signature operations (tsign, tcombine, tverify, shareverify) are abstracted by cardinality checks on receivedRep and boolean flags in receivedFinal
llm_hint.erasure_coding_abstraction: ECCEnc and ECCDec are abstracted using SymbolOf mapping and cardinality-based decoding checks
